design_rationale.why_80: Protocol reserve spec: 8 cells per task × 10 tasks = 80
state_selection: 60 cells from known NC parent states (hard-negative mining from primary labels)
20 cells from TV parent states (exploration: verify TV stability under perturbation)
NC parent states identified per-task from primary Teacher labels
Per-task NC state selection capped at max 4 NC states per task to avoid skew
Remaining slots filled from unexplored parent states within 3-22
perturbation_strategy: Each cell uses a unique (parent_state, perturbation_template, perturbation_seed) triple
Templates P1-P7 applied after set_init_state, before dummy_wait
P0 excluded (already collected in primary at density=1 per state)
Actual (dx,dy,dyaw) recorded in episode_summary, not just template name

rules: Each (task, parent_state, template) appears at most once
NC cells: for each task, pick from nc_states list, cycling through P1-P7 + varying seed
Explore cells: pick parent states NOT in primary NC list, cycling through P1-P7

modifications: Add perturbation AFTER set_init_state, BEFORE apply_dummy_wait
Add target position resolution (fail-closed: RuntimeError if unresolved)
Add initial_state_sha256 computation (qpos+qvel+act hash after perturbation)
